title: Does Visual Rendering Bypass Tokenization? Investigating Script-Tokenizer Misalignment in Pixel-Based Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the image transliteration performance (measured by ChrF++, BLEU, and WER) of pixel-based language models on low-resource non-Latin Indonesian scripts using an English-dominant BPE tokenizer versus a custom grapheme-based tokenizer to evaluate script-tokenizer misalignment and orthographic bias.
